title_zh: Environmental problems — 第43节可背诵讲义
body_en: Environmental problems touch air, water, and waste. Start at home: put rubbish in the right bins and turn off lights you do not use. At school, join a clean-up or a tree-planting day. Talk about one local problem and one possible fix. Small habits, kept by many people, change a city.
body_zh: 环境问题关系到空气、水与垃圾。从家里开始：把垃圾放进正确的桶，关掉不用的灯。在学校参加清洁日或植树。讨论一个本地问题和一个可能的办法。许多人坚持的小习惯，会改变一座城市。
